figures.caption: Figure 5: Accuracy in the passkey retrieval task when individually knocking out the SSM of each layer. The legend indicates the maximum token length of the input.

Table 2: Results of reading time modeling across datasets and model sizes. #sig indicates the number of layers whose predictive power is significant. #ind indicates the number of layers that are found to be independently predictive in the best model search. R2 Max is the value of the regression model with the best-performing layer, with the subscript indicating the index of the best-performing layer. NS = Natural Stories; OS = OneStop; SPR = self-paced reading; FP = first pass time; RP = regression path duration.

Table 1: Results of reading time modeling with Natural Stories and Mamba-130M. ∆MSE indicates the performance of ∆̄t. The three signs in the β rows indicate the direction of the effect of ∆̄t on the ith word due to the ∆t value of the ith word, the (i − 1)th word, and the (i − 2)th word, respectively. ∆MSE is calculated using cross validation, while R2 and β are calculated by fitting a single regression model to the entire data. Significance code: ∗∗∗ : p < 0.001, ∗∗ : p < 0.01; ∗ : p < 0.05
